verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an identity verification service, since some vendors offer on-prem or self-managed deployments, so the axis applies. The evidence pack describes only Plaid-hosted features (Dashboard, Link, Sandbox, webhooks) and never mentions any self-hosted or on-prem deployment option. The Sandbox is a Plaid-hosted test environment, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
